card.name: Counts and percentages in trial results
card.fires_on: Punctuation or spaces inside patient counts and percentages in trial data, just before the denominator or decimal digits, such as the space after "of", the slash in "(10/95)", or the decimal point in "(0.3%)".

modes.label: Space after "of" in counts
modes.description: The space between "of" and the total number in a count such as "27 (93%) of 29".
modes.example: were reported by 27 (93%) of<< >>29 patients in the adult clinical trial

modes.label: Slash in fractions
modes.description: The slash between the number of cases and the group size inside a table cell.

modes.label: Decimal point in percentages
modes.description: The decimal point after a leading 0 in a small percentage in parentheses.
modes.example: 7 of 8240 (0.2%) patients receiving saxagliptin compared to 9 of 8173 (0<<.>>1%) receiving placebo.

card.writes: It prepares the model to output digits for the next number, with no clear link to the listed tokens.
card.plain: It fires at the break just before the second number in a trial count, fraction or percentage.
